description: Source code implementing Linux crash dump handling in the google_breakpad project, including mapping enumeration, ELF file identification, and auxiliary vector processing.

classes.name: LinuxDumper
classes.description: Class responsible for collecting crash dump information on Linux systems, including memory mappings, ELF identification, and auxiliary vector parsing.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the LinuxDumper by reading auxiliary vectors, enumerating threads and memory mappings.

methods.name: LateInit
methods.description: Performs late initialization steps, such as post-processing mappings on Android.

methods.name: ElfFileIdentifierForMapping
methods.description: Generates a unique ELF file identifier for a given memory mapping.

methods.name: GetMappingAbsolutePath
methods.description: Constructs the absolute file path for a memory mapping.

methods.name: GetMappingEffectiveNameAndPath
methods.description: Determines the effective name and path of a mapped file, handling archive and ELF sections.

methods.name: EnumerateMappings
methods.description: Parses /proc/<pid>/maps to enumerate memory mappings, merging adjacent mappings where appropriate.

methods.name: GetLoadedElfHeader
methods.description: Reads ELF header from a loaded module (Android-specific).

methods.name: ParseLoadedElfProgramHeaders
methods.description: Parses ELF program headers to find load and dynamic segments (Android-specific).

methods.name: HasAndroidPackedRelocations
methods.description: Checks for Android-specific packed relocation tags in ELF dynamic segments (Android-specific).

methods.name: GetEffectiveLoadBias
methods.description: Calculates the load bias for ELF shared libraries on Android.

methods.name: LatePostprocessMappings
methods.description: Adjusts mappings for position-independent shared libraries on Android.

methods.name: GetStackInfo
methods.description: Retrieves a portion of the stack given a stack pointer.

methods.name: FindMapping
methods.description: Finds the memory mapping containing a given address.

methods.name: HandleDeletedFileInMapping
methods.description: Handles mappings to deleted files by resolving the original executable path.
